summary: ICL Group Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing it completed a private offering of $800 million aggregate principal amount of senior unsecured notes due 2036. The notes carry a 6.036% coupon, priced at par, issued under Rule 144A/Regulation S. They feature customary covenants, change-of-control repurchase provisions, and optional redemption. Rated BBB- by S&P and Fitch, the notes are approved for trading on TASE UP. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. There are no terms such as a stake, premium, or expected close that warrant classification under the specified categories.
